currency_conversion.note: Every price in the source catalog is PLN netto (no VAT). The product.currency column is fixed to EUR across the whole app (lib/data/projects.ts hardcodes currency: "EUR" in mapRowToProject regardless of the DB row), so all 20 prices were converted PLN → EUR at an approximate rate of 1 EUR = 4.30 PLN and rounded to the nearest 100 EUR for clean price points. This rate is a Facade-stage approximation, not a live FX feed — replace with a real conversion (or a stored PLN price with FX at render time) before this becomes a production concern.

price_tiers.note: OPTIMO (prefabrykowane) and domy mobilne (DA/DL/DI/N2) models list only one price ("Stan wykończony") in the source, so price_min_cents = price_max_cents. CAS (szkieletowe) models list two: "Stan surowy zamknięty" (→ price_min_cents) and "Stan wykończony" (→ price_max_cents). price_includes reflects the fuller "Stan wykończony" bullet list in both cases; the surowy-zamknięty tier for CAS models is a subset of those items (structural shell + roof + windows/doors + soundproofed ceiling, without insulation/interior finish) — not separately encoded since the schema has one priceIncludes array per product.
price_tiers.completion_standard: Set to 'pod-klucz' for all 20 products, reflecting the finished ('wykończony') tier. No model in the catalog offers a true furnished turn-key handover — 'pod-klucz' was the closest of the three enum options (surowy-zamkniety / deweloperski / pod-klucz) to "stan wykończony".

technical_specs_caveats.wallBuildUp / insulation: Taken directly from the catalog's three wall cross-section diagrams (p.13 domy prefabrykowane/OPTIMO, p.31 domy szkieletowe/CAS, p.49 domy mobilne) — one shared layer stack per family group, not per individual model.
technical_specs_caveats.windowClass: PVC trzyszybowe (three-pane PVC) — stated for every model in the catalog.
technical_specs_caveats.ventilation: Not stated per model anywhere in the catalog. Set to 'grawitacyjna' (gravity/natural ventilation) as the defensible default for this construction type absent a stated mechanical system — NOT confirmed with the producer. Note: the ventilation enum (lib/product-technical-specs.ts) has no 'unknown' value, unlike heatTransferCoefficients; the Steel House import (see steelhouse-import-manifest.json precedent in git history) stored the literal string 'nieznana' for this field, which is not a valid enum member — this import deliberately avoided repeating that inconsistency.
technical_specs_caveats.heatSource: Not stated as a fixed spec — heating (grzejniki elektryczne, klimatyzacja, otwór pod komin) appears only in the catalog's "Lista opcji dodatkowych" as buyer-selected add-ons. Set to 'inne' (other/unspecified).
technical_specs_caveats.heatTransferCoefficients (energy class): Not stated anywhere in the catalog. Set to 'nieznana' (a valid enum member for this field).
technical_specs_caveats.fireResistance / windResistance: Not stated in the catalog. Set to the literal string 'nie podano w katalogu producenta' (not stated in the producer's catalog).

images.extraction_method: Programmatic: PyMuPDF (fitz) extracted the embedded raster images per PDF page, filtered by bounding-box position (cover = full-width image at the top of the page; gallery = the 2-3 photo thumbnails in the lower third) to exclude logos, price-banner graphics and icons. Script and output manifest: castor-extracted-images-manifest.json (scratch, not committed) listed the filenames; final files live under public/images/houses/castor/<slug>/.
images.counts: OPTIMO (7 models) and domy mobilne (6 models) have 1 cover + 3 gallery photos each; CAS (7 models) have 1 cover + 2 gallery photos each (the catalog itself shows fewer photos per CAS spread).
images.rights: Same caveat as prior imports (Budman House, Steel House): these are the producer's own catalog renders/photos. Reuse rights were not separately confirmed with Castor before publishing — this import followed the same direct-publish precedent already established for Budman House and Steel House in this repository.

known_gap.producer_directory_mismatch: lib/data/producers.ts (getProducerById) reads from the static fixture lib/data/fixtures/producers.ts, keyed by slug ids like 'prod-castor' — NOT the real DB producer UUID (b6e4d1a2-...) that lib/data/projects.ts joins from the `producer` table. app/[locale]/klient/projekt/[id]/page.tsx calls getProducerById(project.producerId) with the real DB UUID, which will not match any fixture id for Castor (or for Budman House / Steel House, which have the same pre-existing mismatch). This is a known architectural gap predating this import, not something this import introduced or fixed — the fixture entry added here only feeds the homepage ProducerShowcase grid (getProducers()), not the project detail page's producer panel.
